body:
From the maintainer: the session moves to a host with more RAM, so the working
agreements kept in the agent's host-local memory go into the repo as AGENTS.md
(ticket and commit discipline, no push/pull, no history rewrites, release
routine, client parity and nine-locale strings, test pitfalls, host notes, open
threads). A one-line CLAUDE.md imports it so Claude Code loads it on its own.
title: AGENTS.md: standing instructions for agents, so they survive a move to another host
